question_answers.question: How did your company get started? (i.e., How did the founders meet? How did you come up with the idea? How did you decide to be a founder?)
question_answers.answer:
We all combine deep domain expertise in mid-market and enterprise workflow automation. 

Lorenz and Jonas worked together for 4+ years at TradeLink (SCM-SaaS backed by Point Nine, Insight), accompanying the path from 0 to product-market fit. Lorenz led Product; Jonas led Go-to-Market. Both quit their leadership roles to found Finto. 

Knowing each other from the Munich startup scene, Linus joined as Co-Founder & CTO. He was previously an early tech lead at Tacto (Procurement SaaS backed by Sequoia, Index), helping scale it from pre-seed to one of Europe’s largest Series A rounds in mid-market SaaS.

question_answers.question: What is the core problem you are solving? Why is this a big problem? What made you decide to work on it?
question_answers.answer:
Enterprises with complex vendor supply chains produce vast amounts of incoming vendor invoices each year. A typical **mid-market enterprise processes \~100k incoming invoices** **yearly**, and today, an accountant tops out at \~10-20k invoices per year because the real grind is still manual: 

* Key-stroking invoice data to the ERP
* Manual invoice review and compliance checks
* Manual managing deviations with purchase orders
* Manual allocate ledger accounts and cost center codes
* Chasing approvals. That’s why enterprises still staff large accounting teams - or ship the work to shared-service centers.

question_answers.question: What is your long-term vision? If you truly succeed, what will be different about the world?
question_answers.answer:
AI will write the final chapter of accounting software. What once required teams, training, and manual effort now happens in real-time - intelligently, autonomously, and at scale through agents. 

Finto is our contribution to this future. As AI agents become capable of understanding context, learning from company-specific data, and executing complex workflows, entire job profiles will shift away from manual execution. With its predictable but intricate schemes, accounting is poised to be one of the first areas transformed. 

Doubling down on our domain expertise, we are on a mission to **take the manual out of accounting**.

launches.title: Finto - AI Accounting for Enterprises
launches.tagline: The AI accounting software for enterprise finance teams
launches.body:
**Finto - AI Accounting for Enterprises**

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=otqOvfepgKQ

**TL;DR**

Finto builds an AI accounting software for enterprise finance teams. We automate the invoice-to-pay process from their email inbox to their ERP including invoice handling, supplier communication, 3-way matching, and ERP data entry.

**Problem**

Enterprises with complex vendor supply chains produce vast amounts of incoming vendor invoices each year. A typical **mid-market enterprise processes \~100k incoming invoices** **yearly**, and today’s legacy tools force accountants to top out at a fraction of the volume: Real manual grunt work still remains:

* Handling hundreds of mails and documents a day
* Key-stroking invoice data to the ERP
* Manual invoices checks and account coding
* Manual managing deviations with purchase orders
* Chasing approvals

That’s why enterprises still staff large accounting teams - or ship the work to shared-service centers. Our mission is to free the world’s finance teams from repetitive, low-value tasks so they can focus on impactful work. That starts with building a place where everyone can do their best work.

**Solution**

We build a platform embedding AI agents to automate the end-to-end invoice-to-pay cycle:

1. **Classify** inbox documents (invoice, receipts, reminder)
2. **Read** invoices at **99%+ accuracy** - even on line item level
3. **Check** on vendor, tax, bank, and compliance data
4. **Email vendors** automatically if something’s off
5. **Understand & code** ledger, cost-center or project numbers
6. **Three-Way-Match** invoice orders with POs and GRs
7. **Collect** **&** **chase** required approvals
8. **Post to ERP**

Lorenz led Product; Jonas led Go-to-Market. Both quit their leadership roles to found Finto. 

Knowing each other from the Munich startup scene, [Linus](https://www.linkedin.com/in/linus-boehm/) joined as Co-Founder & CTO. He was previously an early tech lead at Tacto (Procurement-SaaS backed by Sequoia, Index), helping scale it from pre-seed to one of Europe’s largest Series A rounds in mid-market SaaS.
